provenance: Physical Android native screenshots and desktop Chromium. Fixture records are synthetic exact-release template renders, not live sessions. Some help filenames end in open but record tap attempts; failed-open screenshots are deliberately retained as failure evidence. Native tap event reproduction hit the tooltip rather than trigger, leaving aria-expanded false while help could remain visible.
privacy: Client-document masking of customer identifiers and detail values; record table bodies hidden. Meta refresh suppressed client-side during capture. Finalized live response refresh and cache headers checked before masking.
limitations: Initial Android run and settled touch retries differed. Settled retries retained where available. Final settled suite stopped during Porsche synchronization after an execution-context error; earlier tests of synchronization/events remain in results. No full live charging lifecycle or naturally unknown-final case was available.
